bar: FOR SURE fires only when ALL hold: PLAIN and EARLY agree on the final side · BOTH reads >= 85% (the desk calibration: the 80-90% band actually hits 95.9%, the 90-99% band 98.1%) · the ask is really read, never null · the ask is >= 3c under the consensus (weaker) model · the ask is under the 88c value line, so a win cannot lose money at the exit. Anything else is NO CALL, printed as plainly.
grading: Graded on MONEY, not direction: $0.50 at the sealed ask, fees in, on the venue's settlement (stand-in index shown beside it, labeled). A directional win that loses money is a money LOSS, in red, no exceptions.

calls.flip_state: FLIP ARMED — one flip can still come before this window ends
reasons: below the FOR SURE bar — PLAIN 62% / EARLY 62% (both must be >= 85%)

calls.flip_state: FLIP ARMED — one flip can still come before this window ends
reasons: below the FOR SURE bar — PLAIN 61% / EARLY 70% (both must be >= 85%)

grade.exit_basis: NO CALL — no press, no money moved

lessons: A clean early read that never needed the second move. The early span's whole edge is deciding 30 seconds sooner with the same model — this window, sooner was right.
